lanes.name: Backlog
lanes.note: Work Terry has explicitly held back, work that is not yet scoped well enough for Bot to perform, and optional umbrella cards that organize executable child cards.

lanes.name: Ready For Work
lanes.note: Work scoped well enough for Bot to perform, ordered by priority. Dependencies on other Ready For Work cards affect execution order, not readiness.

lanes.name: In progress
lanes.note: The one card Bot is actively performing.

lanes.name: Blocked
lanes.note: Neither Bot nor Terry can act until an external condition changes, such as hardware arriving from a vendor.

lanes.name: Needs Terry
lanes.note: Bot work waiting for Terry to answer, approve a recommendation, make a judgment call, or personally act.

lanes.name: Ready for review
lanes.note: Bot believes the work is complete and awaits Terry's review; Bot may not sign off its own work.
